title: 第466章 小阳山秘境第465章 试炼队天界八卦门
slug: 九脉被夺我以魔种证无敌
lines: 以‘枪神’为代号的八卦门年轻男子，咬牙切齿，双眼中似要喷火。
‘我有巨灵根’的表情，也颇为尴尬，已然意识到什么情况了，道：“枪神哥哥，上次打爆你的……就是我剑霸兄弟？”
“没错，就是这个浑蛋！”
‘枪神’显然想到了那一天的经历，更加生气了，道：“当时我已经输了，我还喊了一句让他轻点，可他却依旧一剑狠狠劈下来！”
“害我一个月都进不了天榜空间！”
“巨根妹子，你知道我这一个月是怎么过的吗？”
“我白天修炼，晚上修炼，我就等着再进入天榜空间，找到这个可恶的家伙，我定要用手中长枪戳爆他！”
秦逸道：“枪神兄，当时是我进入天榜空间的第一战，我对这里的情况不了解，更何况，是你主动挑战我的……你修为境界又比我高，所以我不敢怠慢，全力以赴！”
‘我有巨灵根’也连忙点头，道：“枪神哥哥，虽然我没看到那一战，但剑霸兄说过，我辈修士，需认真对待每一场战斗，这是对自身武道的尊重，也是给对手的一份尊重！”
“而且，枪神哥哥你是顶天立地的真男人，不是那种小肚鸡肠的女人，所以，过去的事，就过去了吧！”
‘枪神’的表情，出现了些许细微的变化。
‘我有巨灵根’上前一步，双手拉着‘枪神’的胳膊，晃了晃，道：“枪神哥哥，你就给我一个面子嘛……”
‘枪神’的眉头蹙起，道：“行，上次的事，我就不计较了，但这次既然遇到了，还是要比一场的！”
下一瞬。
秦逸便收到了‘枪神’的挑战。
在天榜空间，交过手的人，一个月内，再次交手，胜负如何，都不再计入积分。
但秦逸跟‘枪神’上一次交手，到现在，早已经过了一个月。
这一点积分，秦逸也不嫌弃，于是接受了挑战。
紧接着，两人脚下的天榜道台，各自弥漫出一片光芒，光芒交汇，化作了一个演武场。
‘我有巨灵根’立刻消耗一点积分，跟了进来观战，急忙喊道：“剑霸兄，枪神哥哥，点到为止啊……别伤了和气！”
‘枪神’盯着秦逸：“上次被你一剑砍爆，我知耻后勇，日夜苦修，各种珍贵丹药当豆子吃，如今已是无量二重！”
“剑霸，看招！”
话音落下，‘枪神’猛地往前一步踏出，身形瞬间激射。
“忘川枪法！”
霎那间，密密麻麻的枪影，朝着秦逸而去。
秦逸手中门板一样的阔剑，猛然横扫而出，强横的力量随之倾泻，顿时，便将无数的枪影劈碎。
紧接着，秦逸亦是一步向前，身形飙射，与‘枪神’展开了激烈的战斗。
‘我有巨灵根’在一旁观战，松了一口气，心中暗道：“剑霸兄明显留手了，也好，经过一番缠斗，再击败枪神哥哥，如此一来，枪神哥哥输了也有面子！”
“我又学到了！”
“这就是做事留一线！”
“活到老，学到老，剑霸兄实乃我的良师！”
秦逸与‘枪神’，足足激战了上百个回合。
最终，秦逸凭借一招八荒伏天剑法中的第七招，一剑定八荒，爆发出极为磅礴浩瀚的力量，击败了‘枪神’。
‘枪神’的身体，不受控制地往后暴退，好不容易稳住身形后，握住长枪的双手止不住的发颤。
秦逸喘着大气，汗如雨下，一副筋疲力竭的样子，然后将阔剑插在地上，拱手道：“枪神兄，承让！”
‘枪神’嘴角一抽，道：“算你厉害，我输了，之前的事，一笔勾销！”
下一刻，秦逸收获一点积分。
他的累计积分，达到了七十九点。

;;
The young man from the Bagua sect, codenamed "Gun God", gritted his teeth and his eyes seemed to be spitting fire.
The expression "I have giant spiritual roots" was also quite embarrassing. He already realized what was going on and said: "Brother Gunslinger, the one who defeated you last time... was my brother Sword Master?"
"Yes, it's this bastard!"
The 'Gun God' obviously thought of his experience that day, and became even more angry, saying: "I had already lost at that time, and I shouted to him to be gentle, but he still struck down hard with his sword!"
"I won't be able to enter the Tianbang space for a month!"
"Girl Jugen, do you know how I spent this month?"
"I practice during the day and practice at night. I'm just waiting to enter the Tianbang space again and find this hateful guy. I will blast him with the spear in my hand!"
Qin Yidao: "Brother Gunslinger, it was my first battle into the Tianbang space. I didn't understand the situation here. What's more, you took the initiative to challenge me... Your cultivation level is higher than mine, so I don't dare to neglect and go all out!"
'I have giant spiritual roots' also nodded quickly and said: "Brother Gunslinger, although I didn't see that battle, Brother Jianba said that monks like us need to take every battle seriously. This is respect for our own martial arts, and it is also a respect for our opponents!"
"Besides, Brother Gunslinger, you are a real man who stands upright and is not a petty woman, so let bygones be bygones!"
There were slight changes in the expression of the 'Gun God'.
'I have giant spiritual roots' took a step forward, took the 'Gun God''s arm with both hands, shook it, and said: "Brother Gun God, just give me some face..."
The 'Gun God' frowned and said, "Okay, I won't care about what happened last time, but since we meet this time, we still have to compete!"
The next moment.
Qin Yi received the challenge from the ‘Gun God’.
In the Tianbang space, those who have played against each other will no longer be counted towards points if they play against each other again within a month, regardless of the outcome.
But a month has passed since the last time Qin Yi and the ‘Gun God’ fought.
Qin Yi didn't mind this point, so he accepted the challenge.
Immediately afterwards, the Tianbang Taoist platform under the two people's feet was filled with light, and the light merged and turned into a martial arts field.
"I have giant spiritual roots" immediately spent some points, followed in to watch the battle, and hurriedly shouted: "Brother Sword Master, Brother Gunslinger, just stop clicking...don't hurt your harmony!"
The 'Gun God' stared at Qin Yi: "The last time I was slashed by your sword, I learned my shame and became brave. I practiced hard day and night and ate all kinds of precious elixirs like beans. Now I am at the second level of the infinite!"
"Sword Master, watch your moves!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the 'Gun God' suddenly took a step forward, and his body shot up instantly.
"Wangchuan marksmanship!"
In an instant, dense gun shadows were heading towards Qin Yi.
The broad sword like a door panel in Qin Yi's hand suddenly swept out, and the tyrannical power poured out, immediately smashing countless gun shadows into pieces.
Immediately afterwards, Qin Yi also took a step forward, shot forward, and started a fierce battle with the 'Gun God'.
'I have giant spiritual roots' watched the battle on the side, breathed a sigh of relief, and thought to himself: "Brother Jianba obviously held back, it's good that after a fight, he can defeat brother Gunslinger. In this way, Brother Gunslinger will have face even if he loses!"
"I learned it again!"
“This is all about keeping a thin line in everything you do!”
"Live and learn until you are old. Brother Jianba is truly my good teacher!"
Qin Yi and the ‘Gun God’ fought fiercely for hundreds of rounds.
In the end, Qin Yi relied on the seventh move of the Eight Desolations Futian Sword Technique to defeat the 'Gun God' with one sword move, unleashing extremely majestic and vast power.
The body of the 'Gun God' retreated uncontrollably. After finally stabilizing his body, the hands holding the spear couldn't stop trembling.
Qin Yi gasped for air, sweating like rain, looking exhausted. Then he inserted the broad sword on the ground, cupped his hands and said: "Brother Gunslinger, I accept!"
The corner of the 'Gun God''s mouth twitched and said: "You are really good, but I lose. All the past events will be wiped out!"
The next moment, Qin Yi gained some points.
His accumulated points reached seventy-nine points.
